dimensions.assessment: Directly affects female members of the Armed Forces who served in specific cultural support teams between 2010 and 2021, and veterans submitting disability claims.
dimensions.evidence: each individual who performed covered service ... member of the Armed Forces ... in a female cultural support team

dimensions.assessment: Substantially alters military recordkeeping, retired pay calculations, and the legal standard for evaluating VA disability or death claims for qualifying individuals.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary shall treat covered service as engagement in combat with the enemy in the course of active military, naval, air, or space service.

dimensions.assessment: Involves adjustments to retired pay calculations, potential new disability compensation awards, and administrative costs for studies and outreach.
dimensions.evidence: the computation of retired pay for each individual who performed covered service.

dimensions.assessment: Mandates changes to individual military service records, VA claims processing guidance, required interagency studies, reports to Congress, and a minor extension of housing loan fees.
dimensions.evidence: The loan fee table in section 3729(b)(2) of title 38, United States Code, is amended by striking 'November 15, 2031' ... and inserting 'December 3, 2031'

dimensions.assessment: Imposes one-year deadlines for record updates, studies, and reports, while providing permanent adjustments to affected individuals' retired pay and veteran benefit evaluations.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than one year after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Secretary concerned shall ensure that the performance of covered service is included

missing_information: Exact total number of service members who meet the criteria for covered service
importance_detail.rationale: Ensures specific female cultural support team members receive proper military service records and retired pay credit, treats their service as combat for VA disability or death claims, requires related agency studies and reports, and extends a VA housing loan fee expiration date by several weeks.

label: H.R. 6036

title: To ensure that certain members of the Armed Forces who served in female cultural support teams receive proper credit for such service.
